text:
Assistant A just repeats the input data and does not extract anything, so it fails the task. Assistant B only gives an introductory sentence and no CSV, so it also fails to deliver. Neither is correct.

Of the two, A's output is a CSV, but it is the wrong one. It is not the requested highest and lowest closing prices per month, and it could mislead a user into thinking it is a valid result. B's output is plainly incomplete, so it is not misleading, but it contains no content at all.

Both are equally unhelpful. Neither gives any of the correct values (Jan: 156.25 / 153.80, Feb: 163.90 / 161.80, Mar: 168.20 / 166.80).
